problem_text: In "The dog barked at the ___," why is AI more likely to complete the sentence with "squirrel" than "my aunt Lucy"?

solution.option: AI knows what dogs usually bark at in real life.
"Squirrel" appears near "barked at" more often in the text AI has seen.
AI was programmed with a list of correct answers.
"Squirrel" is a shorter word, so it's easier to generate.
